title: Counit formula for one coefficient of canonical Picard base change
statement: For morphisms f:X→S, j:W→S, h:T→W of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and an arbitrary O_X-module M, write p_W,q_W,p_T,q_T for the fibre-product projections and v:X_T→X_W for the canonical map [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. Let P denote tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], ε the pinned adjunction counit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], C_A:P_pT P_h A ≅ P_v P_pW A the square comparison made from picardTensorCompIso and v p_W=p_T h, and D_M:P_v P_qW M ≅ P_qT M the coefficient comparison made from picardTensorCompIso and v q_W=q_T. Then P_pT(β_M) followed by ε_pT equals C_(p_W* P_qW M) followed by P_v(ε_pW) and D_M. No structure-unit or base-change invertibility hypothesis is required. The exact formula is the lean.statement below.

proof.text: Represent moduleBaseChangeMap as the inverse horizontal mate of the pushforward square: pushforwardComp(v,p_W).hom, pushforwardCongr of the square equation, and pushforwardComp(p_T,h).inv. The unit identity for inverse mates and the adjunction Hom equivalence identify its component with the defining moduleBaseChangeMap.

Take the inverse vertical mate. iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm identifies this with the inverse conjugate of that pushforward square under the composite adjunctions. Transport each tensor pullback to ordinary pullback via leftAdjointUniq. Its unit and counit equations, and conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv for ordinary pullback, identify this conjugate with C. Thus mateEquiv_counit gives P_pT(moduleBaseChangeMap) followed by ε_pT = C followed by P_v(ε_pW).
The specified β additionally postcomposes with p_T* of D_M. Counit naturality moves this factor through ε_pT. Postcompose the preceding identity with D_M to obtain the stated one-coefficient formula.

lean.statement:
theorem picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap_counit
    {X S W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (j : W ⟶ S) (h : T ⟶ W) (M : X.Modules) :
    (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).map
        (picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap f j h M) ≫
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
        (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j)))).counit.app
          ((tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).obj M) =
    (picardBaseChangeSquareIso f j h
      ((pushforward (Limits.pullback.snd f j)).obj
        ((tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj M))).hom ≫
      (tensorPullback (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)).map
        ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
          (Limits.pullback.snd f j))).counit.app
            ((tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj M)) ≫
      (picardBaseChangeCoefficientIso f j h M).hom
